messages.text: Hello Akeel, Nalini from Malwathu Prints in Ambalangoda. Your linen folder application is here. I am calling to set the first morning.
Hello Nalini. I applied last week and I still want the linen folder post. Please tell me where to come and what to bring.
Come on Monday at 8:30. The branch is a short walk from the clock tower. Ask for Nalini at reception and wear a white shirt.
I can come. Do I pay anything for the shirt, the file, or a seat before that morning?
No. Malwathu Prints does not take a fee, a deposit, or a kit charge. The shirt is your own, and the file is opened at the desk.
If the supervisor keeps me, when does pay start, and who hands me the roster?
Pay is LKR 45500 a month by payroll, in week 1 after you sign. The supervisor writes the roster that morning.
Thank you. I will wear the white shirt, walk from the clock tower, and meet Nalini on Monday at 8:30.

Hello Vidura, mama Roshani Minneriya Timber eken, Embilipitiya branch eken. Oya yawapu net mender application eka mage desk eke. Mula dawasa set karanna call kale.
Hello Roshani. Last week apply kale. net mender post eka mata thama ona. Koheda enne kiyanna, monawa geniyanna kiyanna.
Monday 8:30 ta enna. the clock tower eken podi walk ekak. Reception eke Roshani illanna. white shirt ekak andanna.
Mama enna puluwan. Shirt ekata, file ekata, nathnam eka dawasa kalin seat ekakata salli gewanna ona da?
Naha. Minneriya Timber fee ekak, deposit ekak, nathnam kit charge ekak ganne ne. Shirt eka oya ge. File eka desk eke open karanawa.
Supervisor mama keep karoth pay eka kawadada patan ganne? Roster eka kawuda dennewa?
Pay eka LKR 62500 monthly, payroll eken, contract eka sign unata passe week 3 eke. Eka dawasa ma supervisor roster eka liyanawa.
Thanks. white shirt eka andala, the clock tower eken awilla, Monday 8:30 ta Roshani hamu wenna.
